description: This file contains helper functions for scheduler configuration, including creation of scheduling info, cell configuration requests, and UE configuration requests in a 5G NR context.

methods.name: make_si_scheduling_info_config
methods.description: Creates an SI scheduling configuration based on DU cell configuration, SIB1 length, and SI message lengths.

methods.name: make_sched_cell_config_req
methods.description: Generates a scheduler cell configuration request message from cell index, DU cell configuration, and SI scheduling configuration.

methods.name: create_scheduler_ue_config_request
methods.description: Creates a UE scheduler configuration request based on UE context and resource configuration.
